messages.text: Thursday, October 8 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn Sky, Ancient Myths, and First Responder Support

A mostly clear autumn day offers a high near 70°F, perfect for enjoying local events or looking skyward. This week, state funding is directed towards first responder mental health, and NASA's Roman telescope clears a major review.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 49°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:39 AM and sunset is at 7:03 PM, under a waning crescent moon with 6.6% illumination.
Arts and Music Around Town

In Ypsilanti, the EMU Theatre presents 'Metamorphoses' at the Sponberg Theatre at 7:00 PM. For music lovers, Jordan Blanchard plays a free happy hour concert at Ann Arbor's North Star Lounge starting at 5:30 PM.
Pop's birthday is coming up on October 12.
State Funds for First Responder Mental Health

A statewide initiative to support the mental health of first responders will receive $1.044 million. Funds will be awarded to Frontline Strong Together for police officers, firefighters, EMS personnel, and other critical support staff.
Looking Ahead: Music and History
Tomorrow, catch Scythian at The Ark in Ann Arbor at 8:00 PM, or explore history with the 'If Stones Could Talk' Oakwood Cemetery Tours in Northville starting at 5:00 PM.
Autonomous Navigation and Telescope Readiness

NASA's Starling satellites successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and object catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has also cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting an August 30 launch.
The schedule for Starship's next launch is unset.
Seek out a quiet moment of observation today.
Friday, October 9 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn chill, a hint of warmth, and celestial sights

Today will be overcast and mild, with a high near 71°F. The local civic conversation centers on state funding for first responders and worker health. Elsewhere, NASA's Starling satellites are proving GPS-free navigation.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 71°F and a low around 42°F, with a minimal chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:40 AM and sunset at 7:02 PM, under a new moon with 2.3% illumination.
Local sounds and sights for your Friday
In Ypsilanti, the jam band Backbeat Manifesto plays at Water Tower Distilling Co. at 7 PM. For a different vibe, catch the William Hooker Quartet at Kerrytown Concert House in Ann Arbor at 7 PM.
Pop's birthday is coming up on October 12.
State funding initiatives for critical services

Michigan is allocating significant funds to support first responders' mental health and expand health coverage for low-income workers. Additional funding targets workforce development and housing initiatives across the state.
Looking ahead to weekend events
Tomorrow, consider the "Party of the Century" at The Senate Theater in Detroit, celebrating its 100th anniversary, or the WOMXNHOUSE Detroit opening celebration featuring women and nonbinary artists.
Satellites navigate without GPS, Hubble peers into galaxy's past

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras. Meanwhile, the Hubble telescope has identified evidence of a major merger from the Milky Way's infancy, suggesting an ancient collision with a dwarf galaxy.
The next Starship launch is estimated to be no earlier than September 18, 2026, though this is an independent estimate and not an official SpaceX schedule.
A quiet moment can reveal the day's deeper currents.
